about: Inspect and edit Xcode JSON5 projects
files_help: List entries in the project file tree
validate_help: Validate the supported project schema and invariants
get_help: Extract a value using an RFC 6901 JSON pointer
set_help: Set a JSON5 value at a pointer; preview on stdout by default
remove_help: Remove a value at a pointer; preview on stdout by default
settings_help: Inspect or update project or target build settings
settings_list_help: List build settings without evaluating Xcode conditionals
export_help: Export the semantic model as formatted JSON (discards source formatting)
value_help: JSON5 value; quote strings or use --string
string_help: Treat VALUE as a literal string
key_help: Build-setting key, including any Xcode condition suffix
write_help: Atomically update the input after checking for external changes
output_help: Write to a new file; refuses an existing destination
